Junglee Music presents 'Parvati' (Jab Zid Pe Aa Gayi Parvati), sung, written, and composed by Sadhu Tiwari from the hit movie 'Hanuman Ansh'.
Based on the miraculous life journey of Neem Karoli Baba (Maharaj-ji), Hanuman Ansh has captured hearts worldwide, turning into a massive box-office success through pure audience love. If you are a devotee of Neem Karoli Baba, this film is an absolute must-watch.
Dive into this divine musical journey and experience the divine energy of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Stream the Hanuman Ansh movie songs now!
